headword: ニューラルネットワーク
reading: にゅーらるねっとわーく

definitions.explanation: A computational model loosely inspired by the brain, made of layers of interconnected 'neurons' that learn patterns from data. The foundation of modern deep learning.

notes:
Borrowed from English 'neural network.' A model made of layers of simple units ('neurons') whose connection strengths are adjusted during training so the network learns to map inputs to outputs. Deep networks with many layers underlie modern AI.
